Kourti Legal was born in the trenches of legal practice. Our founding team spent years in active practice navigating the chaos of traditional legal work: juggling spreadsheets for matter tracking, hunting through endless email threads for document versions, and manually monitoring deadlines that should never be missed.
We asked ourselves: why should legal professionals, some of the most highly trained minds in the world, spend so much time on administrative work that technology could handle better?
So we built Kourti Legal. Not as a generic SaaS platform with legal features bolted on, but as a purpose-built solution designed from day one for lawyers, by former lawyers. Every feature, every workflow, every AI capability was crafted with deep understanding of how legal work actually happens.
Today, legal teams across the globe use Kourti to reclaim their time, reduce risk, and deliver better outcomes for their clients. And we're just getting started.

Privacy Policy of Kourti Legal
Last Updated: November 2025
This Privacy Policy describes how Kourti Legal ("Kourti", "we", "us" or "our") collects, uses, stores, discloses and protects personal information of individuals who access our website, platform, or related services ("Services"). By using our Services, you consent to the practices described in this Privacy Policy.
1. Definitions
For the purpose of this Privacy Policy:
"Personal Information" means any information that identifies or can be used to identify an individual, including but not limited to name, email address, phone number, business details, billing information or user credentials.
"Non Personal Information" means information that cannot be used to identify an individual, such as aggregated data, usage analytics or general technical information.
"User" or "You" means any individual or entity that accesses or uses the Services.
"Processing" means any operation performed on Personal Information including collection, storage, use, disclosure, transfer or deletion.
2. Information We Collect
2.1 Personal Information Provided Directly by You
We may collect Personal Information that you voluntarily provide when you:
Create an account on the Kourti platform.
Sign up for updates, newsletters or product releases.
Submit documents, legal briefs, forms or content through the platform.
Request support or engage with our team.
Make payments for any paid services.
2.2 Information Collected Automatically
When you access our website or platform, we may automatically collect:
IP address.
Device and browser information.
Log files, usage data and clickstream activities.
Cookies and similar tracking technologies.
Performance and analytics data.
2.3 Third Party Information
We may obtain information from third party providers, such as payment processors, identity verification platforms or integration partners, as permitted by applicable law.
3. How We Use Your Information
We may use Personal Information for the following purposes:
3.1 To Provide and Operate the Services
Including authentication, document management, workflow automation, billing, and user account administration.
3.2 To Improve Our Platform
Including research, analytics, performance monitoring, product enhancement and testing new features.
3.3 To Communicate With You
Including service updates, policy changes, technical notices, security alerts and customer support messages.
3.4 For Legal and Compliance Purposes
Including adherence to regulatory obligations, investigation of potential violations, fraud prevention and protection of Kourti's rights.
3.5 For Security and Risk Management
Including detection of suspicious activity, prevention of unauthorized access, system monitoring and other protective measures.
4. Legal Basis for Processing (Where Applicable)
Depending on your jurisdiction, our processing activities may be based on:
Your consent.
The necessity of processing for performance of a contract.
Compliance with a legal obligation.
Our legitimate business interests which do not override your fundamental rights.
5. Sharing and Disclosure of Information
We may share Personal Information in the following circumstances:
5.1 Service Providers
We may disclose information to trusted third party vendors who perform functions such as hosting, cloud storage, analytics, communications or payment processing. These parties are bound by confidentiality obligations.
5.2 Legal Compliance or Requests
We may disclose information if required by law, subpoena, court order or government request.
5.3 Business Transactions
In the event of a merger, acquisition, restructuring, asset transfer or similar corporate activity, Personal Information may be transferred to involved parties under confidentiality.
5.4 With Your Consent
We may share your information with third parties when you explicitly authorize us to do so.
We do not sell Personal Information.
6. Data Storage and Security
We use commercially reasonable administrative, technical and physical safeguards to protect Personal Information.
Despite our efforts, no system can guarantee absolute security. Users access the platform at their own risk.
7. Data Retention
We retain Personal Information only for as long as reasonably necessary to fulfill the purposes described in this Privacy Policy unless a longer retention period is required by law.
Users may request deletion of their data, subject to legal and contractual limitations.
8. Your Rights
Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have rights to:
Access the Personal Information we hold about you.
Request correction or updates.
Request deletion or restriction of processing.
Withdraw consent at any time.
Request a copy of your data in a portable format.
info@kourti.com

We use cookies for authentication, analytics, performance measurement and platform optimization. You may disable cookies in your browser settings, although some features may be affected.
10. Third Party Links
Our Services may contain links to external websites or resources. We are not responsible for their privacy practices or content.
11. Updates to This Policy
We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. The updated version will be posted on our website with the effective date. Continued use of our Services constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.
12. Contact Information
For questions regarding this Privacy Policy, contact us at:

The legal profession globally is experiencing a technological renaissance. Nigeria's legal ecosystem is vast and diverse, spanning the Supreme Court to customary courts, elite commercial firms to sole practitioners. Each segment has a different relationship with technology.
Overview of Nigeria's Legal Ecosystem
Over 220,000 enrolled legal practitioners, 130 NBA branches, and in-house legal functions across banking, oil & gas, telecoms, fintech, and FMCG sectors. The judiciary spans federal, state, and customary tiers with varying digital readiness.
The Digital Transformation Journey
From the Paper Era (Pre-2010) through Basic Digitalisation (2010-2018) and Ecosystem Emergence (2018-2023) to the current AI and Intelligent Automation phase (2023-Present).
Key Technology Areas Reshaping Legal Practice
Deep dives into legal research platforms, document automation, contract intelligence, court e-filing systems, AI in legal functions, cybersecurity, NDPA compliance, and legal analytics.
Regulatory & Compliance Technology Landscape
CAMA 2020, Finance Acts, NDPA 2023, Investment and Securities Act 2024, and FIRS digitisation. Plus the NBA's technology initiatives and their impact on practice.
Technology Adoption by Sector
Detailed adoption mapping across 9 segments from large commercial firms (High) to sole practitioners (Low), with primary tools used and key barriers identified for each.
Challenges and Barriers to Adoption
Infrastructure deficits, cost and affordability, skills gaps, cultural resistance, data security concerns, regulatory ambiguity, and vendor ecosystem immaturity.
Opportunities and Recommendations
Targeted recommendations for law firms, in-house legal teams, the NBA and regulatory bodies, and legal technology vendors. Every barrier is also a market opportunity.
The Future of Legal Technology in Nigeria
Generative AI at scale, smart contracts and blockchain, virtual courts, legal marketplaces, data-driven practice management, and RegTech integration through 2030.

entries.title: Encryption everywhere
entries.content:
Encryption everywhere
Data is encrypted in transit with TLS and encrypted at rest. Your documents are protected from the moment they leave your device.
Role-based access control
Every member has a defined role. Seat-based team management means access is granted deliberately — and revoked instantly when someone leaves.
Single sign-on
Enterprise teams can enforce SSO so access follows your identity provider and your existing security policies.
You own your data
Your matters, documents, and client records belong to you. Export them whenever you need, and delete them on request.
Auditable AI
Every AI answer cites the page and verbatim quote it came from, and every AI edit is attributed — so you can verify the work, not just trust it.
Managed infrastructure
Kourti runs on managed cloud infrastructure with isolated environments, automated backups, and monitored access.
Your content stays in your workspace
Matter content is processed only to deliver the features you use inside your own account. We never sell your data.
Tenant isolation
Each organisation’s data is logically isolated. Members only ever see the matters and documents they have been granted access to.
Least-privilege by default
Access to production systems is restricted, logged, and reviewed. New team members start with no access until a role is assigned.
How Kourti Legal protects your matters, documents, and client data — encryption in transit and at rest, role-based access, SSO, tenant isolation, and auditable AI.
